text:
fran: Quick question — when switching from per-route to per-model in Console analytics, should we carry over filters or show a clean model-first slate?

leo: Carry time range + query + model tag. Route-only pins (region, rollout group, capacity pool) should be visible but disabled.

tara: +1. Show a small banner: Some route filters are inactive in model view with CTA 'Open route with these filters'.

mike: Telemetry proposal: emit analytics.saved_query_applied with fields saved_query_id, origin (route|model|cross) and applied_predicates_count. Also emit analytics.filters_pruned with reason (unsupported_in_scope or rollout_inactive) and pruned_count.

leo: Implementation note: do not change saved_query API. Keep scope values route|model|global and compute applicability client-side. Show scope chips on saved items.

fran: Edge case: saved queries that include token-cost buckets or hardware tags that model view cannot apply should be pruned; list pruned predicate keys in tooltip and log pruned_keys for analysis.

ops-bot: Canary flag preserve-filter-pivot scheduled for deploy tomorrow 07:30 PT. Reply to opt out.

tara: Plan: Leo prototypes chips + banner, Mike wires telemetry events, Fran writes a short RFC to preserve API stability, I'll write banner copy and deep-link behaviour. Follow up here with RFC link.
